title: SolidCraft Design Deploy Manifest
description: Configuration for automated SolidCraft CLI exports and GitHub Releases per design folder.

name.description: Design identifier used in exported filenames and release tags (<name>-v<version>).

version.description: Semantic version for this design release (e.g. 0.0.1).

source.description: Path to the SolidCraft source file relative to deploy.yml (e.g. motor-sleeve.sc).

formats.description: Default export formats applied to pieces unless overridden per piece.

body.description: Body name to export (omit to export all bodies).

label.description: Optional variant label appended to the output filename to avoid collisions.

formats.description: Override export formats for this piece.

params.description: Parameter overrides applied before exporting this piece.
